{{For|tutorials|Tutorials/Archer Guide}}
'''Archer''' is a [[Dungeon]] [[class]] that specializes in dealing extreme {{stat|dmg}} through ranged attacks using [[bows]]. It shares the area-clearing ability of the [[Mage]] and the tank-slaying ability of the [[Berserker]], but, in return, is extremely fragile. This class relies heavily on {{stat|cd}} and {{stat|str}}, much like the Berserk class. It is the best class for damage per second (DPS).

== Class Passives ==
*{{AN|Doubleshoot}}: 50% Chance to shoot a second arrow.
*{{AN|Bone Plating}}: Reduces your next incoming hit by {{stat|dmg|X}} (scales with Archer level and {{Stat|cd}}) {{Cooldown|250}}
*{{AN|Bouncy Arrows}}: X% chance for your arrow to bounce to an additional target. {{Cooldown|15}}

== Dungeon Orb Abilities ==
*{{AN|Explosive Shot}}: Shoots 3 arrows that explode on impact, dealing the same {{stat|dmg}} as your highest bow hit in the last minute in a 4 block radius. Can also explode things similarly to {{Item|Superboom TNT}}.
*{{AN|Rapid Fire}}: Shoots 5 arrows per second for 4 seconds! Arrows deal 75.0% of your highest bow hit in the last minute.

== Ghost Abilities ==
*{{AN|Healing Bow}}: Shoot a teammate to heal them for 10% of their max {{stat|hp}} and grant them {{stat|strength|+50}} for 10 seconds. {{Cooldown|10}} Note: does knockback to teammates.
*{{AN|Stun Bow}}: Temporarily stuns any non-boss Dungeon monster for a short period of time when shot. {{Cooldown|5}}

== Leveling Rewards ==
{{/Skill UI}}

You can level up the Archer class while playing as an Archer or if you have a teammate that is an Archer, both of which provide Archer XP as a team bonus.

For every Archer level up you get:
*+1% Extra Arrow Chance
*+1.6% Arrow {{stat|dmg}}
*+2 Bouncy Arrow Chance

For every 5 Archer levels you additionally get:
*-2 Explosive Shot Cooldown

For every 10 Archer levels you additionally get:
*+1 Rapid Fire Duration

At Archer level 50, you receive the following total buffs:
*101% Extra Arrow Chance
*+230% Arrow Damage
*100% Chance for Arrows to bounce of to another target
*-20s Explosive Shot cooldown, lowering the cooldown to 20s
*+5s Rapid Fire Duration, for a total of 8s

== Milestones ==
{{Main|Class Milestones}}
The Archer class can reach its milestones by dealing bow damage in the Dungeon.

== Trivia ==
*The {{Rarity|l|Bone Plating}} passive might be a reference to a ''League of Legends'' rune, as both function very similarly and have the same name.
